nodes.description: Clonally expanded CD8+ cytotoxic T cells infiltrate muscle fibers and directly attack myocytes expressing MHC class I. Perforin and granzyme release leads to muscle fiber necrosis.

evidence.reference_title: A new in vitro model of polymyositis reveals CD8+ T cell invasion into muscle cells and its cytotoxic role.
evidence.snippet: The hallmark histopathology of PM is the presence of CD8+ T cells in the non-necrotic muscle cells.

evidence.reference_title: A new in vitro model of polymyositis reveals CD8+ T cell invasion into muscle cells and its cytotoxic role.
evidence.snippet: CD8+ T cells invade into muscle cells and contribute to muscle injury in PM.
